name: Burlingame
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Burlingame, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Burlingame, CA: Light Up the Square tree lighting, Santa at the library and a Caltrain station on the historic register.
lede: Burlingame lights its tree at the new Burlingame Town Square, hosts Santa and Mrs. Claus at the public library and sends Santa down residents' streets, all a short walk from a historic Caltrain station.
celebrates: Burlingame Parks and Recreation hosts Light Up the Square and Winterfest on Friday, December 4, 2026, with musical performances, sweet treats and a visit from Santa and Sparky as a live tree is lit with 27,000 lights. The city's post calls it the same tradition in a new location, the new Burlingame Town Square. Burlingame Public Library welcomes Santa and Mrs. Claus to the Children's Room on December 15 for photos, and the Parks and Recreation department also sends Santa and his elves down residents' streets in a paid program for Burlingame families.
lastyear: The big change this season is the setting. Burlingame Parks and Recreation said in its post for this year's tree lighting that it was bringing the same tradition to a new home at the Burlingame Town Square, where the live tree is covered in 27,000 lights. Santa and Sparky, the fire department's mascot, join the evening with music and treats. Last season the city's family programs also included the Burlingame Public Library's winter reading calendar and its Santa visit.
facts: In 1868 William Ralston named the land after his friend Anson Burlingame, the United States ambassador to China, and the town of Burlingame was incorporated in 1908. Burlingame Avenue and Broadway are the city's two main retail districts, about a mile apart. The Burlingame Museum of Pez Memorabilia once stood off Burlingame Avenue and claimed to have every Pez dispenser ever sold.
trains: Burlingame Station on Caltrain is listed on the National Register of Historic Places, and it is a short walk from Burlingame Avenue, so families can ride the train to a December evening downtown. Millbrae station, a few miles north, connects BART with Caltrain. For a bigger train day in the city, San Francisco has a cable car museum and a railway museum for streetcar fans.
train_links: The working powerhouse of the city's cable car system, with the winding wheels in view.
A small museum on the Embarcadero about the historic streetcars of the F line.
The nonprofit that keeps San Francisco's historic streetcars running.
traditions: The city's live tree lighting with 27,000 lights, music, treats, Santa and Sparky.
The downtown celebration that follows the tree lighting.
Santa and Mrs. Claus at the library
A December visit and photo opportunity in the Children's Room at 480 Primrose Road.
A city program for Burlingame residents in which Santa rides his sleigh down your block.
kidfact: Burlingame is named for Anson Burlingame, a United States ambassador to China, and its Caltrain station is so old and special that it is on the National Register of Historic Places.
faq: When is the Burlingame tree lighting?
Light Up the Square and Winterfest is listed for Friday, December 4, 2026, with the tree lighting at the new Burlingame Town Square. The city's Parks and Recreation page has the schedule.
Can kids see Santa at Burlingame Library?
Yes. The City of Burlingame calendar lists Santa and Mrs. Claus in the Children's Room on Tuesday, December 15, 2026, from 4:30 to 6 pm.
Is there a way to have Santa come to my street?
Burlingame Parks and Recreation offers Visits from Santa for Burlingame residents for a fee, and the Saturday dates are waitlist only.
Is Burlingame easy to reach by train?
Yes. Burlingame Station is on Caltrain and is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
What else is on Burlingame Avenue in December?
Winterfest follows the tree lighting downtown, and the avenue is one of the city's two main retail districts.
